short:
Every Indian gets ₹1 crore today, and your crore shrinks to about ₹2 lakh without anyone stealing it.
Why can't the RBI just print money and make everyone rich? Inflation explained in 50 seconds. Full story on YouTube.
Who's the best saver in your family? Tell me in the comments.
#whatif #inflation #india

₹1 crore lands in every Indian's account at 8 AM, and by day three your milk, your didi and the sabzi cart are all gone.
What really happens if everyone becomes a crorepati overnight: the money is real, the work isn't. Full story on YouTube.
Guess who loses the most in your house? Comment your answer.
